name: bollinger_squeeze_v1
mechanism: On NIFTY, algorithmic participants — VWAP-execution bots and market-makers delta-hedging gamma from near-expiry option books — temporarily pause directional order flow during mid-session consolidations, creating 2-5 minute compressions where the 4-minute Bollinger Band width contracts inside the Keltner Channel. This squeeze state signals a temporary equilibrium between absorbed buy and sell pressure. When the squeeze releases (BB expands beyond KC), it marks the resumption of institutional directional flow: a single large TWAP or delta-hedge cascade typically drives NIFTY 12-20 spot points in the first 60-90 seconds. The normalized momentum oscillator slope over the preceding 60 seconds distinguishes accumulation (slope turning positive → buy CE) from distribution (slope turning negative → buy PE) at the moment of release.
core_signal_oneliner: 4-minute BB contracts inside Keltner Channel for 6+ bars then expands beyond KC, with momentum oscillator slope confirming direction at the release bar
